S1.title: Unikraft architecture
S1.basis: Modular library-OS APIs, selected platform targets and linked guest binaries.

S2.title: MirageOS
S2.basis: Standalone specialized guest images and library-OS runtime integration.

S3.title: Solo5 execution environment
S3.basis: Guest-facing ABI, host-facing tenders and isolation boundaries.

S4.title: Firecracker production host setup
S4.basis: Hardware isolation plus host-side privileges, syscall, network and resource policies.

S5.title: OCI image specification
S5.basis: Content-addressed descriptors, image metadata and interoperable packaging.

S6.title: OCI runtime specification
S6.basis: Runtime lifecycle and configuration contracts; interoperability is optional here.

S7.title: SLSA v1.2
S7.basis: Build/source assurance tracks and independently verifiable provenance.

S8.title: The Update Framework specification
S8.basis: Trusted update metadata, role separation, version/expiration and rollback defenses.
